subject: SeattleHealth: packaging and credit timeline for compliance add-ons
messages:
From: Maya Cox <maya.cox@seattlehealth.org>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor Hayes <connor.hayes@seattlehealth.org>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: SeattleHealth RFP: compliance add-ons & credits — timeline

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking the RFP. A couple of clarifying items from procurement and IT before we move to commercial terms:

- We need a clear breakdown for the compliance add-ons (audit logs retention tiers, KMS/HSM options, and EU/US residency).
- For onboarding costs (HIPAA implementation, attestation evidence delivery), do you offer a one-time implementation fee or an amortized credit against committed usage?
- Our legal team prefers credits applied up-front or itemized on the first invoice rather than monthly amortization; any flexibility there?
- Timeline: we need commercial terms and SOW redlines by COB 12/15 to make the January board procurement cycle.

Attached is the RFP and our high-level security questionnaire.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Cox
Sr. Contracts Manager | SeattleHealth
Attachment: SeattleHealth_RFP_v2.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Maya Cox <maya.cox@seattlehealth.org>
Cc: Connor Hayes <connor.hayes@seattlehealth.org>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SeattleHealth RFP: compliance add-ons & credits — timeline

Hi Maya — thanks for the RFP and the timeline. Quick summary from our side (high level, so we can converge to redlines tomorrow):

1) Packaging/pricing summary (see attached pricesheet): audit logs retention: 30/90/365 day tiers priced per GB; KMS options: managed KMS (no extra fee) vs dedicated HSM seat (one-time provisioning fee + monthly seat fee).
2) Onboarding/HIPAA evidence: we offer either a one-time implementation fee (one-off) or an equivalent onboarding credit spread over the first 12 months of committed usage.
3) Credit timing flexibility: we can apply a one-time credit on the first invoice if SeattleHealth provides a 12-month minimum committed spend (we can do a blended uplift concession). Otherwise, standard amortized credit over N months.
4) Residency: EU/US variants priced as regional variants of base model with a residency surcharge for dedicated residency (shown in the sheet).

We can absorb the HSM provisioning fee as a concession for the first 3 months if you can commit to a 12-month initial term. Draft SOW and a sample commercial exhibit attached — will send an editable SOW separately for legal redlines.

Next steps: if this structure works, I’ll send an updated SOW with the one-time credit applied and DocuSign link for signatures.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: pricesheet_seattlehealth_v1.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: SeattleHealth concession math

Jonas — quick internal note before we lock canonical language for the SOW:

- If we waive the HSM provisioning fee (approx $18k one-time) and apply a one-time implementation credit of $25k, we need to anchor that to a 12-month minimum commitment and quarterly true-up. Without the commit, economics go negative in month 4.
- Recommend offering: $25k one-time credit (applied on first invoice) + HSM seat waived for 3 months. Add a clause: if committed usage falls short by >25% after quarter 1, SeattleHealth pays back pro-rated credits.
- Legal will likely push back on clawbacks — Laura, can you prepare tight language around usage measurement (UTC-based metering) and true-up windows?

Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: SeattleHealth concession math

Ben — noted. I’ll draft two options for the SOW:

A) One-time credit model: $25k credit invoiced as a negative line on month 1; HSM provisioning fee waived for first 3 months; 12-month commitment; quarterly usage true-up and repayment clause if usage < 75% of commit at end of Q1.

B) Amortized model: same $25k split over first 12 invoices; no payback clause but lower upfront concession (we keep provisioning fee).

I’ll send redline-friendly SOW and mark the specific billing lines and measurement definition (token and embedding units) for the team to validate.

Laura

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Maya Cox <maya.cox@seattlehealth.org>, Connor Hayes <connor.hayes@seattlehealth.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 13:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SeattleHealth RFP: compliance add-ons & credits — timeline

Maya / Connor — following internal alignment, two concrete options for legal and procurement to review (I’ve attached a redline-ready SOW for option A):

Option A (preferred by Redwood):
- $25,000 onboarding credit applied as a one-line negative on the first invoice.
- HSM provisioning fee waived; HSM monthly seats billed after month 3 if used.
- 12-month minimum commitment (commit amount = $X monthly average, defined in exhibit A).
- Quarterly true-up: if usage after Q1 < 75% of committed baseline, pro-rated repayment capped at 50% of credit.

Option B (if SeattleHealth requests no clawbacks):
- $25,000 onboarding credit amortized across first 12 invoices.
- HSM provisioning fee charged upfront.
- 12-month minimum commitment, no repayment clause.

Requested from SeattleHealth by COB 12/15: preferred option and any redlines on the attached SOW (I’m putting the DocuSign link in the next message once terms are agreed).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20m call if you want to run through quickly.

— Jonas

From: Maya Cox <maya.cox@seattlehealth.org>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor Hayes <connor.hayes@seattlehealth.org>, Maya Legal <maya.legal@seattlehealth.org>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SeattleHealth RFP: compliance add-ons & credits — timeline

Jonas — thanks for the clear options and the editable SOW. Legal reviewed and has two requests:

1) We cannot accept a clawback that is tied to runtime metering without a 30-day audit window and a mutually agreed measurement spec. Please add explicit metering definitions (token vs embedding, rounding, timezone) and a 30-day audit clause.
2) For procurement sign-off, finance strongly prefers the credit to appear on invoice 1 (not amortized). They will accept the repayment/clawback if the measurement and audit windows are clear.

We’ve attached a short redline document with suggested SOW language on the audit window and metering spec (see redlines_seattlehealth_sow.docx). Can you incorporate and re-send by 1pm PT so we can route internally to get final procurement approval?

Maya
Attachment: redlines_seattlehealth_sow.docx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Maya Cox <maya.cox@seattlehealth.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SeattleHealth RFP: compliance add-ons & credits — timeline

Maya — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear redlines. We’ll accept the invoice-1 credit presentation plus your audit window asks with the following negotiated points:

- $25k credit applied as a negative line on invoice 1.
- 12-month committed minimum spend required (deal exhibit defines baseline).
- Clawback allowed only after a 30-day audit window; repayment capped at 50% of credit; measurement spec attached in exhibit B (UTC-based token+embedding definition, 1 decimal rounding on GB, sample reporting).
- HSM provisioning fee waived; HSM seats billed beginning month 4 if used.

I’ve updated the SOW with your redlines and pushed the DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/sign/abcdef123456. If SeattleHealth confirms acceptance, please have procurement sign and we’ll start onboarding setup (we’ll provision a staging tenancy and schedule the HIPAA kickoff within 7 business days of signature).

Next steps: sign DocuSign, send PO referencing SEA-2837, and we’ll confirm provisioning dates.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
